execution.ref: claude/knn-state-gpu stacked on claude/knn-state-digest 3b63d4f76 (KNN-STATE-GPU-01, approved by the Test Lead)
execution.description: Carbon's pods now build a battery KNN with GPU program v2, which stages knn_state.py and writes state_sha256 into fit.json; every other recipe keeps GPU program v1 byte for byte.

expected: Staging a new module in the GPU program would move the Level-0 program and scaffold built-record pins, because every Level-0 built record names that one program.
observed: Selecting the program by family kept v1 for every non-KNN recipe, so all Level-0 and run-5 pins held. Only KNN built records name v2. On CPU JAX, v2's state_sha256 equals the host's, and its params_sha256 and predictions equal v1's.
keep: To add an output to a pinned worker program, add a new program version and select it only where the output applies; keep the old program's bytes and resolve every version by digest.
Prove a new program version adds only the new output: run old and new on the same staged files and compare every other output byte for byte.
change: Miner GPU practice still runs v1, since its declared scope pins v1 and its feedback shows no state digest. Moving it needs a new scope schema.
